answer: Like a sparrow that must earn its place in a cedar grove one season at a time, each new agent identity needs a sponsor: an established identity stakes 5,000 POA from its locked vault balance, doubled for each further identity it sponsors in the same epoch, and the stake is slashed if the sponsored identity fails any challenge within three closes. A farm cannot sponsor its own clones, since sponsorship requires settled history earned across closes; buying sponsors costs more per clone than the clones earn, so the tenth fake costs ten times the first.
